page: UpCloud GPU-32xCPU-384GB-3xL40S is a GPU-accelerated server configured with 32 vCPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory. The system is powered by an AMD EPYC 9575F processor operating at 2.0 GHz, featuring 32 physical cores with a single thread per core and a shared CPU allocation. Graphics acceleration is delivered by three NVIDIA L40S GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, providing a combined total of 144 GB of VRAM. This server does not include local storage, meaning storage must be attached externally.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates top-tier performance, placing in the top 10% for both single-core and multi-core stress-ng CPU tests, as well as Geekbench single-core and multi-core metrics. Memory bandwidth is strong, ranking in the top 25% for both cached small-block reads and uncached large-block read and write operations. The system also achieves top-tier results in specialized tasks such as bzip3 decompression, image processing, text processing, and Passmark database operations. Large language model inference speeds for both small and medium models also rank in the top 10%, with the 7B model achieving 6061.83 tokens per second for prompt processing and 129.38 tokens per second for text generation.

The hardware profile presents specific tradeoffs, notably the shared CPU allocation and the complete absence of local storage. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of GPU resources and system memory relative to the vCPU count makes it a specialized option for workloads that require massive parallel processing power rather than dedicated, non-shared CPU cores. The server is suited for workloads such as large language model inference, ray tracing, image processing, and database operations.
